name: SA-11 paper comparison v1
reference: Jan, Experimental validation of ASWING, Part I, p.35 and Figure 22 p.39; numerical ASWING 5.96 curves authenticated by the existing paper/table audit
policy: All four configurations, both figure speeds, three lift and three matched-lift drag samples per curve. Use raw ASWING coefficients, with no experimental drag allowance. Never extrapolate, bridge rejected states, substitute a mesh point by point, or remove missing comparisons from the denominator. Mesh repeats, dimensional duplicates, CDi, Cm and efficiency remain separate regression evidence. This is a changed comparison scope, not new solver improvement or full SA-11 validation.

configurations.name: Bare wing
configurations.setup: Original input, including dCLda=7/rad. Fixed cosine-64 request and 16.466 mm minimum (62 actual intervals). Current-wind influences. No donor airfoil parameters substituted.

configurations.name: Planar extension
configurations.setup: Original input. Fixed cosine-64 request and 16.466 mm minimum (60 actual intervals). Current-wind influences. Modified-cosine trials are a separate candidate, not selected point by point.

configurations.name: Upper winglet
configurations.setup: Disclosed Joint correction and Figure 40's -4 degree upper-winglet twist. Original airfoil data. Fixed 32 main-wing intervals plus 16 per upper winglet under the 16.466 mm minimum. Frozen influences; producing native setup remains unauthenticated.

configurations.name: Upper/lower winglets
configurations.setup: Disclosed Joint-station correction and Figure 40's -4 degree upper-winglet twist. Original CLmax=0.8 retained. Fixed 32+16+16+5+5 intervals under the same minimum. Frozen influences. Sparse saved samples and rejected states remain visible; stall repairs are deferred.
